color.summary: Sail's light slate on white: #1a2c44 for labels and menu rows, #273951 on buttons and fields, #50617a for quiet text, #d4dee9 for every edge and #f4f7fa for the offset surfaces. The one brand color is blurple: #533afd fills the primary button and marks the active nav row, #675dff the form accents. Badges and banners each pair a pale fill with a matching edge and a dark ink of the same hue.
usage: The docs pages color links #5469d4; that is a docs-only override, and the Dashboard links in blurple.
Urgent is the only solid tone: #e61947 with white ink, shared with the destructive button.

type.summary: The system font stack at small sizes: 14px on a 20px line for almost everything, 600 on buttons and labels, 400 in fields and menus. Badges and small labels drop to 12/16. Code is Menlo at 12.6px.

shape.summary: Small corners: 6px on buttons, fields, tooltips and banners, 8px on menus and dialogs, 4px on badges and menu rows.

spacing.summary: Dense, on a 4px step: controls are 28px tall with 8px inline padding, menu rows 32px with 10px padding, badges 20px with 6px.

elevation.summary: Edges are box-shadow rings, not borders: 0 0 0 1px #d4dee9 on secondary buttons and fields. Select triggers add a 0 1px 1px drop; menus and dialogs float on 0 5px 15px black at 12% plus 0 15px 35px. Focus is a 3px sky ring, rgba(1,150,237,.36), outside the edge.
usage: There is no dark mode: the Dashboard ignores the OS setting and has no theme option.

button.summary: Sail buttons are 28px with 8px padding, 6px corners and 14px text at 600. Secondary is white with a #d4dee9 ring and #273951 ink; primary fills blurple #533afd; destructive fills #e61947. Every other button on these pages belongs to the docs site around the examples.
